warnings: Static deployment/source/ABI metadata only; not live authorization, persistent runtime attestation, backing, liquidity, financial safety, successful execution or a complete workflow. Independent grants, policies, pauses and canonical calldata/value controls remain mandatory.

Ethereum current V2 lyUSD vault only, proxy 0x3c769d0e8d21d380228dfb7918c6933bb6ecb6d4 with explorer-resolved current implementation 0x4d462f5fd60b1e4cb3057856d4fce85b48d80bd9. Global owner can upgrade, change managers, fees, APR and manually correct NAV for gains/losses. V1 legacy token products are progressively deprecated and are not admitted.

Shares use 18 decimals; underlying amounts use asset token units. Accounting NAV compounds a configured APR in full days and is not proof of realized RWA proceeds, reserves or backing. Management/performance fees dilute shares; conversion helpers floor using virtual assets/shares, while withdrawal fee shares round up. No slippage/minimum-output/deadline argument exists.

deposit pulls assets only from msg.sender; after deployment-delay maturity impact it mints net shares to receiver and allocates underlying between a liquidity buffer/optional Aave strategy and liquidityManager. mint(uint256,address) is NOT standard exact-output mint: it converts requested shares to assets, then returns actual net shares after the same deposit path; requested share count is not guaranteed.

withdraw(uint256,address,address) floors assets-to-shares then returns actual net assets after fee; it does NOT guarantee the requested asset amount nor return burned shares. redeem returns net assets. Both burn owner shares, spending preexisting allowance when caller differs; instant exit can require caller stake balance and sufficient buffer liquidity. No approval or stake eligibility is granted.

requestWithdrawal burns caller net shares immediately, transfers fee shares where applicable, and records fixed net underlying owed to caller. msg.value must cover mutable withdrawalGasFee; the call forwards the entire contract native balance to feeRecipient, including overpayment, with no refund. Processing is liquidity-manager-only; there is no admitted user claim/cancel or guaranteed payout time.

Local/global pauses and address restrictions can prevent financial actions; eligibility is preexisting and not granted. Source transfer hooks restrict share mint/burn/transfer participants but the direct underlying payout receiver is not separately screened in _withdrawFromVault. Nonpayable calls require zero native value; requestWithdrawal alone is payable. Linked LedgityDataProvider is used by unselected queue view helpers; its deployed runtime identity is not independently attested here.
